scope: Native review of near indirect CALL sites admitted as opaque-indirect-call-v1: instruction identity only. Every target is explicitly unidentified and no calling convention, argument use or runtime ABI compatibility is claimed. Static bytes only; no original execution.

eng1.interpret_word_stream@table_0x1f4.basis: Embedded jump table: every entry is a DIR32 to a local code label; the comparator checks each native entry against its own decoded instruction boundary and the original HIGHLOW inventory.

eng1.interpret_word_stream@bytes_0x244.basis: Relocation-free compiler-local byte table; complete COFF allocation equals the native bytes.
